tokens.name: green-900
tokens.usage: Deep field. The growth chart panel and other single hero surfaces. White or green-300 text only.

tokens.name: green-800
tokens.usage: Text and icons on green-50 / green-100 tints (selected nav, success chips). Link hover.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Brand panels (sign-in hero, phone header band) and link text. White body text passes at 7:1.

tokens.name: green-600
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, focus ring, active nav. The one accent per view. White text passes at 5.2:1.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Brand green from the guide and the logo stroke. Large type (24px+) and marks only: white text on it is 4.3:1.

tokens.name: green-300
tokens.usage: Brand light green. Actual-weight line and points on green-900. Never text on white.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: Avatar ground, selected chip fill, hover on quiet buttons.

tokens.name: green-50
tokens.usage: Success and 'Growing' chip ground, active phone tab, synced block.

tokens.name: yellow-500
tokens.usage: Brand yellow. Breed-standard curve, count badges (with yellow-ink text), 'due soon' dots. Never text on white.

tokens.name: yellow-300
tokens.usage: Border of the owed band and yellow notices.

tokens.name: yellow-100
tokens.usage: Money-owed band ground. Reserved for money people owe the farm.

tokens.name: yellow-ink
tokens.usage: Text on yellow-500, yellow-100 and warning grounds. 13:1 on yellow-100.

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Brand accent orange. Charts only, as the projection gap marker on dark grounds. Not for text or fills under text.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Offline, missed-day and 'running low' notices.

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Border of warning notices and the offline pill.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Body text on warning-bg (9.2:1).

tokens.name: warning-dot
tokens.usage: Status dot for offline / pending. Pair with a word, never alone.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Mortality above last week or above the running average, and 'do this now' dots. 5.6:1 on white: text allowed at any size.

tokens.name: alert-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for alert deltas (▲ from 2) and price-rise chips.

tokens.name: alert-ink
tokens.usage: Text on alert-bg (6.9:1).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind panels. A faint field-green bias so white panels read as paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, forms, modals content.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input fill, quiet rows inside a panel, read-only fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel border and table header rule.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside panels and lists.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input border at rest, secondary button border (3.1:1 non-text contrast is not met: always paired with a filled input ground and label).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and every figure: money, counts, mortality. 18.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: row labels, nav items.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, hints, column headers. 7.3:1 on white, 6.5:1 on ground: safe outdoors.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text only. 4.8:1 on white, 4.5:1 on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on green-700 / green-900 / green-600.

tokens.name: on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on green-900 (10.6:1) and green-700 (5.2:1).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Functional layer only: side rail, phone top bar and tab bar, modals and sheets. Always with backdrop blur(20px) saturate(180%).

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: 1px edge on glass surfaces.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim behind a modal or sheet.
